verdict.line: Buy. A 3-bed here at about $2,500 to $2,600 psf is at or below what the closest competitors' 3-bed-size resales support (about $2,780 psf as a new launch). 3-bed and 4-bed are the most wanted sizes in this own-stay family area.
reasons: The closest competitors (The Florence Residences, Riverfront Residences, Parc Vera) work out to about $2,780 psf as a brand-new launch, after adding 5% where they were not built under the harmonised floor-area rules, a 33% new-launch premium (what launches selling now in the OCR charge over their closest resale, 13 launches) and 10% for this project being integrated.

The Florence Residences (779 m away, 1,410 homes, completed 2023): its 3-bed-size resales (about 850 to 1,150 sq ft) averaged $2,025 psf over the last 6 months (17 resales), against a median $1,904 psf for all sizes. A 3-bed here at about $2,547 psf is $522 psf (+26%) above that; a 3-bed there sold for a median $2.12M.
Bought at the expected $2,547 psf, the base case makes about +44% after stamp duty and selling costs by 2032 (7.5% a year); bought at $2,780 psf it makes about +31%.

Building, finance, fees and other costs

compsNote: 3 of the 3 competitors are within 1 km. Near-twins come first: up to two condos within 1.5 km with a similar number of homes (half to double) completed in 2016 or later. Then every suitable condo within 1 km (same tenure, completed 2011 or later first), widening to 2 km and 3 km only if fewer than 3; executive condos are left out. Resale prices are URA medians for the last 6 months where there were at least 5 resales, otherwise the last 12 months. Condos launched before June 2023 measured their areas under the old rules (including air-con ledges), so their psf is raised 5% to compare like for like.
priceDecide: Like for like by size: for each unit type we take each resale competitor's average psf for units within about 15% of that size (last 6 months, or 12 or 24 if too few). Each is raised by the 33% new-launch premium that launches selling now in the OCR carry over their closest resale (13 launches). Buy at or below = the average of the competitors' new-launch equivalents for that size; walk away above = 5% more. 2-bed: buy at or below $2,670, walk away above $2,800, this project about $2,477 psf; 3-bed: buy at or below $2,780, walk away above $2,920, this project about $2,547 psf; 4-bed: buy at or below $2,740, walk away above $2,880, this project about $2,607 psf. This project's price by unit type follows how psf changes with size among the competitors (smaller units usually cost more per sq ft).  The developer breaks even at about $2,060 psf (EdgeProp's method); launches since 2023 priced on average 27% above break-even, which points to about $2,620 psf.

gain.timeline: Buy at launch (UOL targets the second half of 2027). TOP is targeted for 2030 or 2031; Seller's Stamp Duty applies for 4 years, so we look at a sale in 2032, about a year after TOP (5 years). CICT expects the mall's construction to start only in 2027.
gain.costs: Potential gain is after Buyer's Stamp Duty at IRAS rates, about $6,000 legal fees and a 2% agent fee plus 9% GST when you sell. Loan interest, property tax, maintenance and rent are not included.
scen: Half the base case: competing supply at the exit, or a softer market.

district.summary: Hougang is in a maturing phase: steady growth, deep resale liquidity, and very little new private supply nearby.
rows: URA non-landed index 134.9 (Q3 2016) to 212.7 (Q3 2026): about 4.7% a year islandwide. Hougang's 2018–19 launches grew 3.4% to 3.7% a year from launch to 2026 (Riverfront, The Florence).
Analysts expect $2,500 to $2,600 psf here; The Florence and Riverfront (both completed 2023) trade at $1,904 and $1,747 (before the 5% area adjustment).
100 resale condos within 3 km. The Florence had 103 resales and Riverfront 110 in the past 12 months. How fast units sell: Not available yet.
Gross yields: The Florence 2.6%, Riverfront 2.7%, Sengkang Grand 2.4%. URA: rents in the suburbs (OCR) rose 3.1% in Q3 2026.
No other new private project within 2 km; the first government land sale in the area since 2019. About 830 homes here reach TOP together.
district.line: This district is maturing: prices have risen steadily and there is little competing supply, but the expected launch price is well above what the nearest condos support.

exit.mopNote: HDB 4-room and bigger flats completed from 2021 that reach their 5-year minimum occupation period by about 2032, in the towns resale buyers come from (HDB Property Information, data.gov.sg). New MOP flats add fresh upgraders.
exit.note: How we test each buyer group, in today's money (prices, HDB values and incomes tend to rise together): the unit at today's expected price; a 25% down payment plus Buyer's Stamp Duty; HDB upgraders put their flat's sale proceeds in first (median resale price, minus an illustrative $150,000 loan). The group can buy if that capital covers the down payment and stamp duty; the income the remaining 30-year loan needs (tested at 4% under the 55% TDSR) is shown against SingStat's 2025 averages by home type, excluding employer CPF (4-room $11,097, 5-room and executive $13,887, condo $22,006). HDB resale prices rose 4.2% a year over the past 10 years, so upgraders' capital usually grows too. Singaporean HDB owners who buy before selling pay 20% Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty upfront and get it back only if they sell the flat within 6 months (IRAS).
exit.line: In this own-stay family area, the 2-bed resale pool is wide; the 3-bed resale pool is good; the 4-bed resale pool is good.

fplans.note: Main layout per bedroom type (most units where counts are published), redrawn from the developers' plans in the Stacked Homes directory. Score out of 10, same rules for every plan: start at 4; +1 regular shape, dumbbell, kitchen that can be closed off, kitchen or yard window, AC ledge and planter under 5%, store or shelter or utility room; −1 long corridor, ledge and planter 10% or more, balcony over 12%. Efficiency = the share of the area not taken by AC ledges, planters, bay windows and corridors. Plans under the 2023 rules exclude AC ledges from the strata area, so their sq ft is all usable.
